column1: Daily life|a1|bakery-last-roll|Ask for the last bread roll|The tray has one roll left. Ask whether you can have it and whether you can pay by card.|Kann ich das letzte Brötchen haben? Kann ich mit Karte bezahlen?|Can I have the last roll? Can I pay by card?|Das letzte Brötchen refers to the specific roll you can see. Use mit Karte for the payment method.|Ask for the last pretzel instead. Notice how das letzte Brötchen changes to die letzte Brezel.

Daily life|a1|laundry-room-free|Check if a washing machine is free|A machine has finished, but clothes are still inside. Ask whether it belongs to the person waiting.|Entschuldigung, ist das Ihre Wäsche? Ist die Waschmaschine danach frei?|Excuse me, is that your laundry? Is the washing machine free after that?|Ihre Wäsche is formal. Danach makes it clear that you want the machine after the clothes are removed.|The owner says it is someone else’s laundry. Ask if they know when the machine will be free.

Daily life|a1|swap-taller-glass|Ask for a taller glass|At a café the glass is small. Ask for a larger one without complaining.|Könnte ich bitte ein größeres Glas bekommen?|Could I have a larger glass, please?|Glas is neuter. Ein größeres Glas agrees with that noun in the request.|Your tea is cold. Ask for another cup of tea using the same polite request pattern.

Daily life|a1|bin-collection-day|Ask when a bin is collected|Your new neighbour mentions bin collection. Ask which day the paper bin is emptied.|Wann wird die Papiertonne geleert? Am Dienstag oder am Mittwoch?|When is the paper bin emptied? On Tuesday or Wednesday?|Papiertonne means the bin for paper. The second question makes the choice easy to answer.|You need the glass bin instead. Ask whether you can take glass there on a Sunday, then listen for the local rule.

Daily life|a1|market-half-kilo|Buy half a kilo of apples|You want half a kilo of apples and want to check the total before paying.|Ein halbes Kilo Äpfel, bitte. Was macht das zusammen?|Half a kilo of apples, please. How much is that altogether?|Ein halbes Kilo gives the quantity. Zusammen asks for the total.|You now want one kilo of pears and half a kilo of apples. Ask for both in one turn before requesting the total.

Daily life|a1|borrow-umbrella-return|Borrow an umbrella until tomorrow|It starts raining as you leave a friend’s home. Ask to borrow an umbrella and say when you will bring it back.|Kann ich deinen Regenschirm ausleihen? Ich bringe ihn morgen zurück.|Can I borrow your umbrella? I’ll bring it back tomorrow.|Regenschirm is masculine, so the object pronoun is ihn. Zurück belongs at the end in the second sentence.|You need the umbrella through the weekend. Promise to return it on Monday and change deinen to Ihren for a neighbour.

Daily life|a1|queue-place-check|Check where the queue begins|Two lines have formed. Ask where to wait for the checkout and whether this person is in that queue.|Ist das die Schlange für die Kasse? Stehen Sie auch hier an?|Is this the line for the checkout? Are you in this line too?|Anstehen splits into stehen and an in the question. Kasse identifies the line you need.|The person says they are waiting for returns, not the checkout. Ask which line is for paying.

Public transport|a1|one-stop-ticket|Ask if a short-trip ticket covers one stop|You need to travel one stop and see a short-trip ticket. Ask whether it is valid for your journey.|Ich fahre nur eine Station. Gilt das Kurzstreckenticket für diese Fahrt?|I’m only going one stop. Is the short-trip ticket valid for this journey?|Gilt asks about the specific ticket’s validity. Rules vary by transport network, so listen for the local answer.|Replace one stop with two and name your destination. Ask specifically whether changing trains is allowed with that ticket.

Public transport|a2|bus-detour-stop|Find a replacement stop after a detour|Your bus no longer stops at the library because of roadworks. Ask where to board instead.|Wo kann ich stattdessen einsteigen? Hält der Bus am Rathaus?|Where can I board instead? Does the bus stop at the town hall?|Stattdessen refers to the alternative. Hält asks whether the bus stops at a named place.|The town-hall stop is closed too. Ask if the replacement stop is within walking distance of the library.

Public transport|a2|lift-out-of-service|Ask for a step-free route|The lift is out of service. Ask which route serves platform 3 without stairs.|Der Aufzug ist außer Betrieb. Wie komme ich ohne Treppen zu Gleis drei?|The lift is out of service. How do I get to platform three without stairs?|Name both the obstruction and your requirement. Ohne Treppen is the constraint the answer needs to address.|You need the opposite platform. Ask whether there is a ramp from the main hall while the lift is closed.

Public transport|a2|wrong-direction-tram|Check the direction before boarding|The route number is correct, but you are unsure which direction the tram runs. Ask about the final stop.|Fährt diese Straßenbahn Richtung Messe? Was ist die Endhaltestelle?|Is this tram going towards the exhibition centre? What is the final stop?|Richtung asks about travel direction. Endhaltestelle helps distinguish the two trams on the same route.|One tram displays a short-turn destination. Ask whether you need to change at the next stop to reach the exhibition centre.

Public transport|a2|missed-connection-plan|Ask for the next connection|Your inbound train is late and you missed your connection to Kassel. Ask about the next available train.|Ich habe meinen Anschluss nach Kassel verpasst. Wann fährt der nächste Zug dorthin?|I missed my connection to Kassel. When does the next train there leave?|Dorthin refers back to Kassel. State your destination before asking for the next option.|There is a bus as an alternative. Ask whether it goes directly to Kassel or whether you have to change again.

Public transport|b1|bike-carriage-position|Find the bicycle carriage|You have a bicycle. Ask which part of the train has spaces and where to wait on the platform.|In welchem Wagen gibt es Fahrradplätze? Wo soll ich auf dem Bahnsteig warten?|Which carriage has bicycle spaces? Where should I wait on the platform?|Fahrradplätze answers what you need. Auf dem Bahnsteig answers where to wait, so it takes the dative here.|The bicycle spaces are full. Ask where bikes are allowed on the next train instead.

Public transport|b1|delay-proof-request|Request written confirmation of a delay|You need written confirmation for an appointment you missed. Explain what happened and ask whom to contact.|Mein Zug ist mit vierzig Minuten Verspätung angekommen. Wo bekomme ich eine schriftliche Bestätigung?|My train arrived forty minutes late. Where can I get written confirmation?|Mit … Verspätung gives the amount of delay. Schriftlich distinguishes a document from a verbal answer.|You need the confirmation by email. Ask whether it can include both the booked time and actual arrival time.

Home and neighbours|a2|parcel-for-next-door|Return a parcel left at your door|A parcel with your neighbour’s name was left at your door. Tell them where you found it and ask if it is theirs.|Dieses Paket lag vor meiner Tür. Es ist an Sie adressiert. Gehört es Ihnen?|This parcel was outside my door. It’s addressed to you. Is it yours?|Gehören takes the dative, so use Ihnen. Vor meiner Tür describes where it lay.|Nobody answers next door. Write a one-sentence note saying you have the parcel and when they can collect it.

Home and neighbours|a2|quiet-after-ten-request|Ask a neighbour to lower the volume|You can hear loud music late in the evening. Explain that you need to get up early and ask for quieter music.|Ich muss morgen früh aufstehen. Könnten Sie die Musik etwas leiser machen?|I have to get up early tomorrow. Could you turn the music down a little?|Give the reason briefly. Etwas leiser makes the requested change specific.|You would rather agree on a quiet time for future evenings. Propose turning the music down after ten.

Home and neighbours|a2|radiator-cold-report|Describe a cold radiator to the landlord|The bedroom radiator has been cold since yesterday. Say where the problem is and ask when someone can check it.|Die Heizung im Schlafzimmer bleibt seit gestern kalt. Wann kann jemand vorbeikommen und sie prüfen?|The heating in the bedroom has stayed cold since yesterday. When can someone come by and check it?|Seit gestern says when it started. Sie refers to die Heizung.|The repair person can come while you are at work. Ask for a time slot in the afternoon and whether you have to be home.

Home and neighbours|b1|building-key-handover|Arrange a spare-key handover|You must hand over a spare key, but the other person arrives after you leave. Propose an agreed place and ask for confirmation.|Da ich schon um acht losmuss, könnte ich den Ersatzschlüssel bei Frau Roth abgeben. Wäre das für Sie in Ordnung?|Since I have to leave at eight, I could leave the spare key with Ms Roth. Would that be all right with you?|Bei Frau Roth specifies who will hold it. Ask for confirmation before acting.|Frau Roth is also away. Offer a direct handover that evening and ask when the other person can meet.

Home and neighbours|b1|shared-hallway-boxes|Negotiate space in a shared hallway|Boxes in a communal hallway make it hard to pass. Ask when they can be moved and suggest a temporary spot.|Die Kartons stehen so, dass man kaum vorbeikommt. Könnten wir sie bis morgen in den Abstellraum stellen?|The boxes are placed so that it is hard to get past. Could we put them in the storage room until tomorrow?|So, dass links the position to its consequence. Bis morgen sets a temporary limit.|The storage room is locked. Ask the owner to move the largest box first so that people can pass.

Home and neighbours|b1|moveout-meter-reading|Agree on a move-out meter reading|At move-out, check who records the electricity reading and whether both sides receive the record.|Wer liest bei der Übergabe den Stromzähler ab? Bekommen beide Seiten eine Kopie des Protokolls?|Who reads the electricity meter at handover? Do both sides get a copy of the record?|Zähler ablesen means taking the reading. Keep that action separate from receiving a copy.|The other person has an older reading. Ask to compare both readings and agree which date the record refers to.

Home and neighbours|b2|laundry-schedule-disagreement|Propose a fair laundry schedule|Two flats need the laundry room on Sunday. Acknowledge the competing schedules and suggest a recurring split.|Ich verstehe, dass Sie sonntags ebenfalls waschen müssen. Wie wäre es, wenn wir die Zeiten aufteilen und die Vormittage abwechselnd nutzen?|I understand that you also need to do laundry on Sundays. How about splitting the times and alternating the mornings?|Ebenfalls acknowledges the shared need. Abwechselnd defines how to rotate access.|Your neighbour cannot alternate mornings. Offer alternating full weekends instead and explain what you would keep fixed.

Appointments and services|a1|haircut-exact-length|Explain how much hair to cut|You want two centimetres taken off, only at the ends. Say both details before the haircut starts.|Bitte nur die Spitzen schneiden, ungefähr zwei Zentimeter.|Please trim only the ends, about two centimetres.|Nur restricts the request to the ends. Ungefähr signals that two centimetres is approximate.|Ask that the hair at the front stays long while the ends at the back are trimmed.

Appointments and services|a2|delivery-window-change|Move a delivery window|A delivery is booked for Monday morning and you will not be home. Ask for Monday afternoon or Tuesday.|Ich bin am Montagvormittag nicht zu Hause. Ist die Lieferung am Montagnachmittag oder am Dienstag möglich?|I won’t be home on Monday morning. Is delivery possible on Monday afternoon or Tuesday?|Name the current slot and two alternatives to avoid a vague rescheduling request.|Tuesday is full. Ask if Monday after four is possible and request confirmation of the updated slot.

Appointments and services|a2|library-card-documents|Check documents for a library card|Ask if you can register today and whether an ID is enough to get a card.|Kann ich mich heute anmelden? Reicht mein Ausweis für den Bibliotheksausweis?|Can I register today? Is my ID enough for the library card?|Reicht asks whether the document is sufficient. The two Ausweis compounds identify different cards.|You only have a passport. Ask if the library also needs proof of your address.

Appointments and services|a2|alteration-pickup-time|Confirm when altered trousers will be ready|A tailor has shortened your trousers. Ask whether you can collect them Friday after 4 p.m.|Kann ich die Hose am Freitag nach sechzehn Uhr abholen?|Can I pick up the trousers on Friday after 4 p.m.?|German uses singular die Hose here. Nach sechzehn Uhr gives the earliest pickup time.|You cannot collect the trousers yourself. Ask whether another person can collect them with your receipt.

Appointments and services|b1|ask-for-itemised-receipt|Request an itemised invoice|A repair invoice shows only a total. Ask for labour and parts to be listed separately.|Könnten Sie mir bitte eine Rechnung schicken, auf der Arbeitszeit und Ersatzteile getrennt aufgeführt sind?|Could you send me an invoice listing labour and replacement parts separately?|Auf der refers to the invoice. Getrennt aufgeführt specifies how the charges should appear.|You receive a list with no dates. Ask when the repair took place and whether the date can be added to the invoice.

Appointments and services|b1|reschedule-missed-call|Follow up after a missed appointment call|A service provider called while you were working. Explain why you could not answer and offer a callback window.|Ich konnte Ihren Anruf vorhin nicht annehmen. Sie erreichen mich heute zwischen fünfzehn und siebzehn Uhr.|I couldn’t take your call earlier. You can reach me today between 3 and 5 p.m.|Zwischen … und gives a clear window. Vorhin refers to an earlier time on the same day.|The person reaches voicemail again. Leave your name, purpose and one more precise ten-minute window.

Appointments and services|b2|quote-before-extra-work|Ask for approval before extra repairs|You are leaving a bike for repair. Ask the shop to send a quote before carrying out any work beyond the agreed service.|Falls weitere Arbeiten nötig sind, schicken Sie mir bitte zuerst einen Kostenvoranschlag. Ich möchte die zusätzlichen Arbeiten vorab freigeben.|If more work is needed, please send me a quote first. I’d like to approve any additional work in advance.|Falls states the trigger. Vorab sets the time at which you want to approve it.|The quote arrives with a range. Ask which repair is necessary now and which work you could postpone.

Study and campus|a2|seminar-room-moved|Find the replacement seminar room|Your room is locked and a notice says the seminar has moved. Ask which room it is in and whether the time changed.|In welchem Raum findet das Seminar jetzt statt? Beginnt es weiterhin um zehn Uhr?|Which room is the seminar in now? Is it still starting at ten?|Stattfinden separates in the first question. Weiterhin checks whether the original time remains valid.|The room number is clear, but it is in another building. Ask whether you should enter through the courtyard.

Study and campus|a2|borrow-reference-book|Ask about a reference-only book|A book label says Präsenzbestand. Ask whether you can take it home or only use it in the library.|Darf ich dieses Buch ausleihen, oder kann ich es nur hier lesen?|May I borrow this book, or can I only read it here?|Nur hier contrasts local use with borrowing. Read the label again before assuming it can leave the building.|Ask whether you can photocopy a short section if the book cannot leave the reading room.

Study and campus|b1|submit-assignment-file|Ask if a replacement file is accepted|You uploaded the wrong PDF and the submission portal is closed. Explain the error and ask whether you can send the correct file.|Mir ist beim Hochladen ein Fehler unterlaufen. Darf ich die richtige Datei per E-Mail nachreichen?|I made a mistake while uploading. May I submit the correct file later by email?|Nachreichen means supplying something after the original submission. Ask for permission and name the exact file.|The instructor allows email. Draft a subject line and identify the corrected file in a one-line reply.

Study and campus|b1|share-group-project-tasks|Divide a group project by deliverable|Your group needs to research, write and present. Volunteer for research and ask who can prepare slides.|Ich kann die Quellen recherchieren und zusammenfassen. Wer übernimmt die Folien für die Präsentation?|I can research and summarise the sources. Who will take responsibility for the presentation slides?|Übernehmen assigns responsibility. Name the deliverable instead of asking vaguely who will help.|The team has no slides yet. Propose a first draft by Thursday and name who will check the sources.

Study and campus|b2|office-hours-research-scope|Narrow a research question in office hours|You have a broad question about transport. Propose narrowing it to weekday bus access in one district and ask if that scope is feasible.|Ich würde die Fragestellung auf die Busverbindungen an Werktagen in einem Stadtteil eingrenzen. Halten Sie diesen Umfang für realistisch?|I would narrow the research question to weekday bus connections in one district. Do you think that scope is realistic?|Eingrenzen names the change. Umfang refers to what you can realistically cover.|The lecturer thinks your scope is still too wide. Specify a date range and explain what you would exclude.

Study and campus|b2|seminar-quote-context|Challenge a seminar interpretation politely|A classmate reads a quotation as a general claim. Point out that it describes one sample and ask if the conclusion should be narrower.|Die Aussage bezieht sich offenbar auf diese Stichprobe. Sollten wir die Schlussfolgerung deshalb vorsichtiger formulieren?|The statement apparently refers to this sample. Should we phrase the conclusion more cautiously for that reason?|Offenbar leaves room for correction. Stichprobe identifies the evidence you are discussing.|The classmate finds a second study with similar results. Say what that supports and which claim still seems too broad.

Study and campus|c1|abstract-scope-limitation|State a limitation in a research abstract|Your fictional study interviewed volunteers at one campus. Write a sentence that limits what can be concluded.|Da ausschließlich Freiwillige an einem Standort befragt wurden, lassen sich die Ergebnisse nur eingeschränkt auf andere Hochschulen übertragen.|Since only volunteers at one location were surveyed, the findings can only be transferred to other universities to a limited extent.|A limitation specifies the sample and the affected claim. Nur eingeschränkt avoids overgeneralisation.|Add a second limitation about self-reported behaviour without repeating the first limitation in different words.

Workplace|a2|shift-swap-handover|Ask to swap shifts with a colleague|You have an appointment on Friday morning. Offer to take the colleague’s Saturday shift in exchange.|Kannst du am Freitagmorgen meine Schicht übernehmen? Dafür könnte ich am Samstag für dich arbeiten.|Can you take my Friday morning shift? In return, I could work for you on Saturday.|Dafür introduces the trade. Confirm any workplace approval separately.|Your colleague can cover only the first half. Confirm the handover time and say who will ask the manager about the rest.

Workplace|a2|machine-label-out-of-order|Write a short out-of-order sign|A meeting-room printer will not work. Tell colleagues to use the printer on the second floor.|Der Drucker ist außer Betrieb. Bitte benutzen Sie den Drucker im zweiten Stock.|The printer is out of order. Please use the printer on the second floor.|An effective sign names the broken item and the alternative. Im zweiten Stock gives the location.|The alternative printer is on the same floor, behind reception. Rewrite the sign to use this location.

Workplace|b1|handover-pending-order|Hand over a pending customer order|A customer has paid, but the item will arrive tomorrow. Tell the next colleague what is done and what still needs action.|Die Kundin hat schon bezahlt. Die Ware kommt voraussichtlich morgen. Bitte ruf sie an, sobald die Lieferung eintrifft.|The customer has already paid. The goods are expected tomorrow. Please call her as soon as the delivery arrives.|Schon marks completed work, and sobald identifies when the colleague should act.|The item arrives damaged. Hand over what changed and ask the colleague to contact the customer before pickup.

Workplace|b1|correct-meeting-minutes|Correct a detail in meeting minutes|The minutes show Wednesday, but you agreed on Thursday. Ask for the correction and quote the correct deadline.|Im Protokoll steht Mittwoch. Wir hatten Donnerstag, den zwölften, vereinbart. Könnten Sie den Termin bitte korrigieren?|The minutes say Wednesday. We agreed on Thursday the twelfth. Could you correct the date, please?|Quote both old and new values. The article den introduces the date in this formulation.|The date is correct but the owner is wrong. Write the corrected line and specify who should make the update.

Workplace|b2|flag-deadline-dependency|Flag a dependency before a deadline slips|You need data by Tuesday to send a report Friday. Explain the dependency and suggest what to do if the data arrives late.|Damit der Bericht am Freitag fertig wird, brauche ich die Daten bis Dienstag. Andernfalls würde ich zunächst eine vorläufige Fassung verschicken.|For the report to be ready Friday, I need the data by Tuesday. Otherwise, I would first send a provisional version.|Damit introduces the objective. Andernfalls connects the fallback to missing the Tuesday deadline.|The data will arrive Wednesday morning. Give a revised schedule and say what you can prepare before the data arrives.

Workplace|b2|ask-priority-conflict|Ask a manager which task takes priority|You have two tasks due today and time to finish only one. Share the impact and ask for a priority decision.|Wenn ich heute die Kundenanfrage bearbeite, kann ich die Auswertung erst morgen abschließen. Welche Aufgabe hat Vorrang?|If I handle the customer query today, I won’t finish the analysis until tomorrow. Which task takes priority?|Erst morgen communicates the schedule impact. Vorrang asks for an explicit decision.|Your manager prioritises the request. Confirm what you will postpone and when you will send a progress update.

Workplace|c1|disagree-risk-estimate|Challenge a risk estimate constructively|A team estimates low risk using last year’s data, but the current process changed. Acknowledge the evidence and propose a check.|Die Vorjahresdaten sind ein sinnvoller Ausgangspunkt. Da sich der Ablauf geändert hat, würde ich die Einschätzung anhand aktueller Stichproben überprüfen.|Last year’s data is a sensible starting point. Since the process has changed, I would verify the estimate using current samples.|Acknowledge what the evidence supports and state why it may not carry over. Offer a concrete verification step.|The team can only review ten records. Explain what a small sample might catch and what uncertainty will remain.

Customer service|a2|split-bill-by-drinks|Split a bill correctly|You will pay for two coffees. Your friend will pay for the cake. Explain the split to the server.|Wir zahlen getrennt. Die beiden Kaffees zahle ich, und den Kuchen zahlt meine Freundin.|We’re paying separately. I’ll pay for the two coffees and my friend will pay for the cake.|Getrennt sets the arrangement. Repeat who pays for each item.|A third friend joins and shares the tea. State which items that friend pays for and which remain yours.

Customer service|a2|wrong-food-delivered|Ask for the dish you ordered|You ordered the vegetarian dish but received a different one. Point out the mistake and ask for the original order.|Ich hatte das vegetarische Gericht bestellt. Könnten Sie mir bitte das richtige Gericht bringen?|I ordered the vegetarian dish. Could you bring me the correct dish, please?|Refer back to the order before requesting the replacement. Das richtige Gericht identifies what you want.|The waiter says the original dish is unavailable. Ask for another vegetarian option and whether the price is the same.

Customer service|a2|sold-out-ticket-alternative|Ask for another performance time|The evening show is sold out. Ask whether seats are available for the afternoon performance the next day.|Sind für die Vorstellung morgen Nachmittag noch Plätze frei?|Are there still seats for tomorrow afternoon’s performance?|Noch asks about remaining availability. Morgen Nachmittag identifies the alternative slot.|There are two nonadjacent seats. Ask whether there are adjacent seats at a later performance.

Customer service|b1|warranty-repair-dropoff|Explain an intermittent fault at drop-off|Your headphones only stop working after several minutes. Describe the pattern and say you brought the receipt.|Die Kopfhörer funktionieren zunächst, aber nach einigen Minuten fällt der Ton aus. Den Kaufbeleg habe ich dabei.|The headphones work at first, but after a few minutes the sound cuts out. I have the receipt with me.|Zunächst and nach einigen Minuten make the fault reproducible. Mention the receipt without claiming a specific warranty outcome.|The fault now occurs only while walking. Name the changed condition and ask staff to write it on the intake form.

Customer service|b1|double-charge-explanation|Ask about two charges for one order|The same amount appears twice on your statement. State what you see and ask whether one charge will be reversed.|Der Betrag wurde offenbar zweimal abgebucht. Könnten Sie prüfen, ob eine der Buchungen rückgängig gemacht wird?|The amount appears to have been debited twice. Could you check whether one of the charges will be reversed?|Offenbar leaves room for pending charges or another explanation. Ask for verification before asserting a refund.|The second amount is still pending. Ask when you should check again before escalating.

Customer service|b2|courier-photo-wrong-door|Explain why a delivery photo does not match|A courier marked your parcel delivered, but the photo shows a red door and yours is blue. Provide the evidence and request an investigation.|Laut Sendungsverfolgung wurde das Paket zugestellt. Auf dem Foto ist jedoch eine rote Tür zu sehen, während meine Tür blau ist. Bitte prüfen Sie die Zustellung.|According to tracking, the parcel was delivered. The photo shows a red door, however, while my door is blue. Please investigate the delivery.|Separate the courier’s claim from the evidence. Während connects the two contrasting observations.|The photo shows the correct door but a different floor number. Describe the discrepancy without claiming to know where the parcel is.

Customer service|b2|subscription-cancellation-proof|Ask for confirmation of a cancellation|You submitted a cancellation online. Ask for its effective date and written confirmation that billing stops after that date.|Bitte bestätigen Sie mir schriftlich, zu welchem Datum der Vertrag endet und ab wann keine weiteren Beträge mehr abgebucht werden.|Please confirm in writing when the contract ends and from when no further amounts will be debited.|End date and last billing date can differ. Ask for both instead of assuming they match.|A confirmation lists the end date but no final charge. Ask one focused follow-up about the pro-rata amount.

Reading and listening|a1|swimming-pool-lane-notice|Read a pool lane notice|Read: Bahn 3 ist heute von 14 bis 16 Uhr für einen Kurs reserviert. Can you use lane 3 at three? When does the reservation end?|Nein. Um fünfzehn Uhr ist Bahn drei reserviert. Die Reservierung endet um sechzehn Uhr.|No. At three p.m. lane three is reserved. The reservation ends at four p.m.|Von … bis gives the time interval. Bahn means lane in this pool context.|Replace 14–16 Uhr with 9–11 Uhr. Can you use lane three at half past ten? Answer in a full sentence.

Reading and listening|a1|school-lunch-voicemail|Pick out a lunch order from a voice message|Ask a partner to read this once, then answer without looking: Für Lea bitte Nudeln ohne Käse. Abholen um zwölf Uhr. Who is it for, what is excluded and when is pickup?|Für Lea. Ohne Käse. Um zwölf Uhr.|For Lea. No cheese. At noon.|Listen for the short phrases after für, ohne and um. Repeat the three fields back before checking the transcript.|Ask your partner to change the name, cut the pickup time by one hour and replace Käse with Soße. Repeat the three changed details.

Reading and listening|a2|parcel-locker-deadline|Read a pickup deadline|Read: Ihre Sendung liegt bis einschließlich Samstag im Fach. Ab Sonntag geht sie zurück. Can the recipient collect it on Saturday? What happens Sunday?|Ja, am Samstag ist die Abholung noch möglich. Ab Sonntag wird die Sendung zurückgeschickt.|Yes, collection is still possible on Saturday. From Sunday the parcel will be sent back.|Einschließlich includes Saturday. Ab marks the beginning of the next period.|Change Saturday to Thursday and Ab Sonntag to Ab Freitag. Work out the last possible pickup date before checking the wording.

Reading and listening|a2|workshop-materials-announcement|Listen for what to bring to a workshop|Have a partner read: Papier bekommen Sie vor Ort. Bringen Sie bitte eine Schere und Klebstoff mit. What do you bring, and what will be provided?|Eine Schere und Klebstoff mitbringen. Papier gibt es vor Ort.|Bring scissors and glue. Paper is available on site.|Mitbringen introduces what learners bring. Vor Ort identifies what is supplied there.|Change the announcement so that participants receive scissors instead and need to bring coloured paper. Listen for the change in what is provided.

Reading and listening|b1|festival-weather-change|Find which event changed due to weather|Read: Das Konzert im Park zieht in die Stadthalle um. Der Flohmarkt findet wie geplant draußen statt. Which event moved, and which did not?|Das Konzert findet jetzt in der Stadthalle statt. Der Flohmarkt bleibt draußen.|The concert is now at the town hall. The flea market remains outdoors.|Umziehen means changing venue here. Wie geplant tells you the other event is unchanged.|Suppose the flea market goes indoors too, but opens an hour later. Write two separate lines that state each change.

Reading and listening|b1|office-access-announcement|Distinguish normal and temporary access|Read: Normalerweise benutzen Gäste den Haupteingang. Wegen Bauarbeiten gelangen sie bis Freitag über den Hof ins Gebäude. Where should guests go this week?|Sie sollen bis Freitag über den Hof ins Gebäude gehen. Der Haupteingang ist der normale Weg für Gäste.|Until Friday they should enter through the courtyard. The main entrance is the usual route for guests.|Normalerweise introduces the default. Wegen Bauarbeiten explains the temporary change.|Ask a partner to specify that deliveries still use the side door. Say which entrance applies to guests and which to deliveries.
